newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end slow day lower.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end slow day lower.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended the day lower on light volume, holding mid-range amidst consolidation after the Swiss National Bank cut interest rates last Thursday.
The curve flattened slightly after steepening on news last week that the SNB cut its discount rate by 0.5 percentage points to 1.00 percent, matching a historic low.
At midafternoon on Monday, traders said only one contract traded in the December Comi medium-term bond futures contract.
The December Confederate bond futures contract was seen stalled in a range between 113.80 to the downside and roughly 114.50 to 114.55, the contract high, to the upside.
Dec conf futures CONFZ6 down 17 at 114.08.
Dec comi medium-term bond COMIZ6 down 15 at 109.75
Dec Euro Swiss francs FESZ6 down four at 98.37.
